title: Electoral Integrity Dark Money Elimination and Campaign Transparency Bill
source_or_instruction: Public interest reform proposal enforcing absolute prohibition of anonymous political donations, real-time digital contribution tracking, public campaign funding, ban on state-funded political advertising prior to elections, and intra-party elections.
notes: Matter 023: Electoral Integrity Dark Money Elimination and Campaign Transparency Bill, 2026.
